sloka: मृगा मृगीभि: सहिता बहव: पृषता वने ।मनोज्ञरूपा लक्ष्यन्ते कुसुमैरिव चित्रिता: ॥ २.९३.१९॥
transliteration: mṛgā mṛgībhi: sahitā bahava: pṛṣatā vane ।manojñarūpā lakṣyante kusumairiva citritā: ॥ 2.93.19॥

translations.english: In this forest many a dappled deer with their mates looking as if painted with flowers are seen wandering about with a charming appearance.
